And the contract states the BACKWARD compatibility rule of the registry subject
    And the subject name and the AsyncAPI document location of the type are read from configuration, not written in code

edits.old: And a failed publish leaves the event in the outbox, never lost, and the incident is the relay's, not a message to the user
edits.new:
And a failed publish leaves the event in the outbox, never lost, and the incident is the relay's, not a message to the user

  Scenario: AC9 BR7, BR8 and BR9 hold on the store path (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a document row for case "RW-2026-000301" is stored with a personal-data pattern in one of its four columns
    When the store transaction commits and the relay runs
    Then the payload and the header carry only the four references and codes of BR7, and the build test refuses the personal-data pattern
    And the outbox row commits in the same transaction as the row, and the relay publishes it every minute
    And no interaction row is written and no ledger writer is called

  Scenario: AC10 An error answer of a provided operation is 401, 403 or 404 as the contract states (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a caller of a provided operation of this service
    When the caller has no valid credential, lacks the right, or names an unknown resource
    Then the answer is 401, 403 or 404 respectively, and no document row or outbox row is written

  Scenario: AC11 A consumed call that fails or does not answer leaves the event pending (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the store commits a document row for case "RW-2026-000301" while a consumed call is unavailable or gives no answer
    When the store transaction commits
    Then the document row and its outbox row are kept, the event stays pending, and the relay retries it on the next run
    And no success answer is returned to the user for the failed call
